title: The task projection reads each record in its own words, and the second reader names a task as it does
note: AUD-072 to AUD-074. One create per task (TP1); a create names its submitter, tool, inputs and dependencies as the writer does (TP2, TP3); a record names its task, one a create introduced, its states and its role, and carries a lease the projection can read, each refused in its own words (TP4 to TP8); the second reader names a task by its record's task_id and refuses a create naming no work (TP9, TP10). tests/test_task_projection_records.py holds each.

mutations.name: TP1_a_second_create_replaces_the_task
mutations.rationale: a VERIFIED task reads CREATED under the second record's tool and submitter

mutations.name: TP2_a_create_may_name_no_work
mutations.rationale: a create naming no submitter, tool or inputs raises KeyError out of the projection

mutations.name: TP4_a_record_may_name_no_task
mutations.rationale: a record naming no task, or naming one by a list, raises out of the projection

mutations.name: TP5_a_record_may_name_a_task_never_created
mutations.rationale: a record for a task never created raises KeyError out of the projection

mutations.name: TP6_a_state_name_raises_its_own_error
mutations.rationale: a state that is not one raises ValueError out of the projection

mutations.name: TP7_a_role_name_raises_its_own_error
mutations.rationale: a role that is not one raises ValueError out of the projection

mutations.name: TP8_a_lease_may_carry_anything
mutations.rationale: a lease with a field no lease has, or one that is a list, raises TypeError out of the projection

mutations.rationale: the second reader folds a create naming no tool or inputs, which the primary refuses
